title: Generate parametric, manufacturable 3D models in seconds
summary: Kyra AI is a platform that generates parametric, manufacturable 3D models in seconds using artificial intelligence. It allows users to create production-ready designs quickly without requiring extensive CAD expertise.
problem_solved: It solves the time-consuming and complex process of creating manufacturable 3D models by automating parametric design generation.
why_valuable: Dramatically accelerates product design workflows and democratizes access to manufacturing-ready 3D models for non-experts.
